'''Senni Otek''' was the chief [[Technician/Legends|technician]] of the ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]''.

==Biography==
Otek was born on Lianna to parents who were [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] at [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. While she inherited their technological aptitude and curiosity, she didn't like the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] as they did. She managed to make it through school without professing loyalty to the Empire, and attempted to make contact with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The Empire found out and arrested her parents in an attempt to force her to comply with the New Order. The Rebels put together a strike team and rescued her, but her parents were killed in the battle.<ref name="AJ6" />

Otek joined the Rebel Alliance and was assigned to a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. She participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. After the conflict, she assisted [[Korren Starchaser]] in designing the ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]'' and joined his crew.<ref name="AJ6" />
